answer: Each agent's voting weight equals the signed inference runs it logged this epoch, and validators re-run one marble-hard sample from every batch before counting a single ballot. Forging a thousand identities costs a thousand independent inference jobs plus a thousand grading passes, an umber ledger entry every attacker must pay in full. Payout stays flat per head while cost scales linearly, driving a sybil farm to its nadir and exposing it to random audit and slashing. Only the enrolled key signs a run, so copying that key copies the audit trail and the slash with it.
